manifestReasoning: Connects to the local MCP server via WebSocket (port range 9223-9232 for multi-instance). No external network access.
readmeNotice: > **Sonda MCP Connect** is a fork of [southleft/figma-console-mcp](https://github.com/southleft/figma-console-mcp) (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 Figma Console MCP Contributors). It keeps the full read and write toolset and runs in **local mode only**: the cloud relay domain was removed from the plugin manifest. To pull upstream updates run `git fetch upstream`, merge, then `node scripts/rebrand.mjs`.
